inventoryScope: Declared implemented profile and explicit exclusions, not an exhaustive assertion of every requirement in the upstream specification.

areas.scope: Create before update, duplicate rejection, delete/recreate and immutable committed snapshots.

tests.title: requires creation, rejects duplicate creation and clears state on delete/recreate

areas.scope: Forward references, replacement of one definition, retained unrelated data, duplicate/cycle rejection without partial mutation.

tests.title: component updates replace individual definitions, retain unrelated data and reject duplicates/cycles atomically
incremental component replacement agrees with the last accepted definition

areas.scope: RFC 6901 escaping, root and nested replacement, omitted-value deletion, array index preservation and sparse upsert.

tests.title: uses RFC 6901 escaping and transactional upsert/replacement/delete semantics
escaped pointer segments round-trip independent string keys

areas.referenceLimit: Pinned reference deletes explicit null; normative Lyra behavior retains null. reference-results.json labels this divergence explicitly.

areas.scope: Nested child-list scopes, absolute versus relative pointers, per-instance writes and bounded expansion.

tests.title: scopes nested templates, keeps absolute bindings absolute and writes only the selected instance
bounds expanded template work and rolls back data that exceeds the instance budget

areas.scope: Only explicitly registered functions; nested evaluation, checks before dispatch, resolved event context and local effects behind host authorization.

tests.title: evaluates nested admitted functions and rechecks validation before dispatch
rejects unresolved action context and unregistered local functions explicitly
host effects never run in bindings, checks, arguments or event contexts

areas.scope: Owner/revision checks, opaque active instance identities, stale action/write/update/delete rejection after recreation.

tests.title: rejects prior-lifetime actions, writes and guarded mutations after same-owner surface recreation
keeps a retired rendered action inert when the same owner recreates the same surface and component IDs

areas.scope: Actual Lyra chart/table/stat/citation components, data updates, native keyboard action, deletion and current-viewer source authorization.

tests.title: renders the owned stable chart/table/stat/citation profile through create, update, native action and delete
rechecks viewer source access at activation and replaces revoked citations with an explicit fallback

areas.scope: Pinned AG-UI 1.0 HTTP/SSE host contract and A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC metadata/extension admission, only the owned report catalog allowlist.

tests.title: pinned AG-UI HttpAgent admits only the owned report metadata contract through real HTTP/SSE
pinned A2A client/server activates the exact extension and admits message metadata through JSON-RPC

areas.scope: Three unchanged official examples, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, 320px and 800px: visible content, heading/button roles, native keyboard action, relative row/column geometry, updates and deletion.

unsupported.scope: Candidate protocol envelopes in the stable processor
unsupported.behavior: Explicit rejection; candidate catalog export remains separate.

test.title: owns snapshots, rejects non-JSON payloads and refuses candidate envelopes in stable processing

unsupported.scope: Undeclared catalog members and functions, ambiguous dynamic values
unsupported.behavior: Explicit rejection; no silent interpretation of arbitrary functions or properties.

test.title: rejects a value that is ambiguous between catalog literal data and a binding

unsupported.scope: Full standard basic catalog and global qualified binding registry
unsupported.behavior: Not advertised; supportedCatalogIds remains empty without an explicit host qualification assertion.

test.title: keeps transport catalog advertising empty after local rendering qualification
